description: This is a FastAPI Python source file defining REST API endpoints for managing appointment bookings in a medical scheduling system. It includes functions for patients to book appointments, doctors to confirm/reject, and users to view appointments, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions.

classes.name: AppointmentStatusChangeRequest
classes.description: Data model for requests to change the status of an appointment, with validation and description annotations.

methods.name: models.Patient get_current_patient( db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Retrieves the patient ORM object for the current user, ensures user is a patient.

methods.name: models.Doctor get_current_doctor( db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Retrieves the doctor ORM object for the current user, ensures user is a doctor.

methods.name: book_appointment( payload: schemas.AppointmentCreate, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), patient: models.Patient = Depends(get_current_patient), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Allows a patient to book an available appointment timeslot with a specific doctor, creating an appointment record and marking the slot as booked.

methods.name: confirm_or_reject_appointment( appointment_id: int, status_req: AppointmentStatusChangeRequest, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), doctor: models.Doctor = Depends(get_current_doctor), )
methods.description: Allows a doctor to confirm or reject a pending appointment; if rejected, frees the timeslot.

methods.name: list_my_appointments( db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Returns all appointments involving the current user, whether as patient or doctor.

methods.name: get_appointment_by_id( appointment_id: int, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Fetches an appointment by its ID if the current user is involved in that appointment.
